overview: The St Leonards Guesthouse, at 22 Queens Road in central Shanklin, offers en-suite rooms including family rooms and singles. Breakfast is cooked daily with locally sourced ingredients, and guests have a lounge bar with a large TV, DVDs and board games, plus a garden and patio. Shops, bars and restaurants are about five minutes' walk away.
